commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 certify (PR #1300): diff changes the Brazil gate in every generated composition from `not entry_is_line_b` to `not entry_is_section_232_aluminum` and re-grounds the steel parameter proof from 9903.81.87/.88 to 9903.82.02; report says "The task's 9903.81.x locator is stale for this corpus vintage".
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs, and gain a Section 232 steel component the witness never had.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The Brazil IEEPA carve-out keyed on the witness exemplar flag `entry_is_line_b` rather than on Section 232 aluminum membership as HTS 9903.01.77's aluminum exception requires, so the surcharge fired and was suppressed on the wrong sets of entries.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 12. Chapter-prefixed steel parameter is ch23_s232_steel_heading_rate.
triage.verifier_justification: The diff changes encoded meaning in two rule versions, replacing the Brazil IEEPA surcharge gate `not entry_is_line_b` — a witness-exemplar line index with no counterpart in the cited source — with `not entry_is_section_232_aluminum`, the membership criterion the source actually uses; the module's own proof atom on that formula cites "The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02.", and the pinned corpus confirms 9903.01.77 is the Brazil +40% heading while 9903.85.02 is the §232 aluminum membership heading. It is not a rename: both flags are live caller inputs in the same file (post-fix `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` still reads `formula: entry_is_line_b`), and it is not unclaimed new scope, since the module's unchanged summary already declares "section-232 aluminum ... are caller inputs supplied by entry preparation" for this chapter-wide generated composition. The fix re-grounds an ungrounded condition onto the provision that states it, which is untraceable_branch rather than unrepresented_clause (the exception existed, mis-grounded) or boundary/amount/polarity (no strictness, number, or logic inversion changed).
